name: 2027 AAEA Annual Meeting
call_type: Selected papers and posters; organized symposia
deadline_note: Abstract Management System opens in early November 2026. Organized symposia proposals are also due 13 January 2027; track sessions are sponsored by AAEA Sections.
submission_requirements: Selected presentations: two-page maximum, single-spaced abstract without author names, contact information or sources. Accepted selected-paper authors upload the full paper (PDF) by 12 May 2027; under 25 pages (no more than 10,000 words) preferred.
membership_required: Paper and poster presenters must be current 2027 AAEA members and registered for the meeting by 12 May 2027
